# Prove It Works

Examine each task output against the real thing.
Do not infer that it is correct from a proxy, a self-report or a passed compile.

## Why

A proxy, such as a file time, can seem cheaper than the real value.
A wrong inference costs much more than a read of the source.
When a check fails, question the method of observation before the system.

## Script the check

The strongest proof is a deterministic script that runs the comparison again.
Keep the script and its output for a reviewer.
Commit it only when large work needs an audit trail (`astack-show-me-your-work`).

You skipped this principle when your proof is a report and not an observation.
